College: blank paper corners, small curled sheets, pencil shavings, tiny leaflets, eraser pieces and pencil fragments; cafe: leaves and a few coffee beans; court: leaves and tiny seed tufts; beach: sea-spray droplets and pale coastal petals; airport: blank ticket slips; home: delicate petals and dust glints.
